Frequently Asked Questions

Have a quick question? Browse our most common inquiries below.

You can donate online via our secure donation page using a credit card, PayPal, or bank transfer. We offer both one-time and monthly giving options. 100% of your donation goes directly to programmes.

Yes. The Bloom Forward is a registered non-profit organisation. Donations are tax-deductible to the extent allowed by law in your country. You'll receive a receipt by email after donating.

Visit our Get Involved page and complete the volunteer registration form. Our volunteer coordinator will reach out within 5 business days to discuss opportunities that match your skills and availability.

Absolutely. On our donation page you can direct your gift to any of our six programmes, or to "Where Most Needed" so we can allocate funds to the areas of greatest impact.
